verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an Excel or Google Sheets add-in, let alone one that pulls live Pigment data into spreadsheets and writes edits back. The only related material is generic mention of native connectors, open APIs and scheduled imports, which are adjacent integration features rather than a bi-directional spreadsheet add-in. A spreadsheet add-in is a fair question for a planning platform, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, a bi-directional Excel or Google Sheets add-in pulls live data into my spreadsheets and pushes edits back
